svg.title: Furnished upstairs revision: tucked laundry wall, swapped Bath 2 and Closet 2
svg.desc: A furnished preliminary diagram, not an implemented model. Bath 2 and Closet 2 swap positions: the nine by five-foot bathroom is east, and the 5.3 by 7-foot closet is west with single-sided two-foot hanging and north drawers. Both doors open from Bedroom 2; its full bed moves east to clear their sweeps and its four-foot desk stays on the south wall. The laundry gallery-side wall moves east 2.075 feet to meet the counter ends, returning about 17.3 square feet to the gallery without changing the exterior. Laundry is now 13.425 by 8 feet clear with a three-foot nominal west entry between counter runs. Counters wrap north and east above side-by-side east-wall machines, with a south folding run interrupted at the furnace entry. North and south counters leave 45.3 inches before handles; a separate route reaches furnace without crossing illustrative 18-inch machine-door projections. Primary closet storage wraps west, south and east, with bath-only entry. Mechanical remains a six by five-foot provisional upstairs-furnace and service reservation, not a selected furnace size or approved installation. No bedroom rugs or dressers or gallery furniture are added. Exterior-face area remains 2,042.5992 square feet, 42.5992 over target. Products, occupied routes, simultaneous door and appliance operation, equipment replacement, storage capacity, headroom and structure remain unverified. The 3D model is unchanged.
